# google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config

Manages the per-model configuration for a Vertex AI Model Garden publisher
model in a given location (regional or `global`).

Each publisher model has a single configuration per project and location;
creating or updating this resource authoritatively replaces that
configuration, and destroying this resource clears all configuration settings
on the publisher model.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about PublisherModelConfig, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1beta1/projects.locations.publishers.models/setPublisherModelConfig)
* How-to Guides
    * [Inference metadata logging](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/capabilities/inference-metadata-logging)
    * [Use models in Model Garden](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-garden/use-models)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Publisher Model Config Basic


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config" "config" {
  provider  = google-beta
  region    = "us-central1"
  publisher = "google"
  model     = "gemini-2.5-flash"

  inference_event_logging_config {
    state = "ENABLED"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Publisher Model Config Full


```hcl
resource "google_bigquery_dataset" "logs" {
  provider                   = google-beta
  dataset_id                 = "publisher_model_logs"
  location                   = "US"
  delete_contents_on_destroy = true
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config" "config" {
  provider  = google-beta
  region    = "us-central1"
  publisher = "anthropic"
  model     = "claude-3-5-haiku"

  inference_event_logging_config {
    state = "ENABLED"
  }

  logging_config {
    enabled             = true
    sampling_rate       = 0.5
    error_sampling_rate = 0.5
    enable_otel_logging = true

    bigquery_destination {
      output_uri = "bq://${google_bigquery_dataset.logs.project}.${google_bigquery_dataset.logs.dataset_id}.request_response_logs"
    }
  }

  claude_feature_config {
    advanced_ai_enabled = false
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Publisher Model Config Data Sharing


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config" "config" {
  provider  = google-beta
  region    = "us-central1"
  publisher = "anthropic"
  model     = "claude-sonnet-4-5"

  data_sharing_enabled_provider = "ANTHROPIC"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `publisher` -
  (Required)
  The Model Garden publisher identifier, for example `google` or `anthropic`.

* `model` -
  (Required)
  The publisher model identifier, for example `gemini-2.5-flash` or `claude-sonnet-4-5`.


* `inference_event_logging_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configures emission of the per-request
  `aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request` Cloud Logging log, which
  records structured per-request metadata (such as principal, traffic type,
  and token usage) for publisher-model traffic on the model. This is
  distinct from `logging_config`, which logs raw request and response
  payloads to a BigQuery table.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_inference_event_logging_config).

* `logging_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for logging prediction requests and responses to a BigQuery
  table.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_logging_config).

* `claude_feature_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for Claude-specific features on Anthropic publisher models.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_claude_feature_config).

* `data_sharing_enabled_provider` -
  (Optional)
  The model provider (publisher) for which the customer has enabled data
  sharing. For publisher models that are configured to require data
  sharing, a prediction request is only allowed when the model's publisher
  matches this provider; otherwise, the request is rejected.
  Possible values are: `ANTHROPIC`.

* `region` -
  (Optional)
  The location of the publisher model, for example `global` or `us-central1`.
  If not specified, the provider region is used.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_inference_event_logging_config"></a>The `inference_event_logging_config` block supports:

* `state` -
  (Required)
  Whether emission of the `aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request`
  log is enabled.
  Possible values are: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`.

<a name="nested_logging_config"></a>The `logging_config` block supports:

* `enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Whether request-response logging is enabled.

* `sampling_rate` -
  (Optional)
  Percentage of requests to be logged, expressed as a fraction in the
  range `(0, 1]`.

* `error_sampling_rate` -
  (Optional)
  Percentage of failed requests to be logged, expressed as a fraction in
  the range `[0, 1]`. Only non-transient errors (such as `500/Internal`
  errors) are logged.

* `enable_otel_logging` -
  (Optional)
  Used for large models. If true, in addition to the original large
  model logs, logs are converted into OpenTelemetry schema format and
  saved in the `otel_log` column. Defaults to `false`.

* `bigquery_destination` -
  (Optional)
  BigQuery destination for request-response logging.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_logging_config_bigquery_destination).


<a name="nested_logging_config_bigquery_destination"></a>The `bigquery_destination` block supports:

* `output_uri` -
  (Required)
  BigQuery URI to a project, dataset, or table, up to 2000
  characters long, in the form `bq://projectId`,
  `bq://projectId.bqDatasetId`, or
  `bq://projectId.bqDatasetId.bqTableId`. When a 3-part table URI is
  specified, the dataset must already exist; when a 1-part or 2-part
  URI is specified with `enabled = true`, Vertex AI creates and
  persists a `request_response_logging` table URI. Prefer a full
  3-part `bq://projectId.bqDatasetId.bqTableId` URI to avoid plan
  diffs from server-side table name defaults.

<a name="nested_claude_feature_config"></a>The `claude_feature_config` block supports:

* `advanced_ai_enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether advanced AI features (data retention opt-in) are
  enabled for this publisher model.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/publishers/{{publisher}}/models/{{model}}`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


PublisherModelConfig can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/publishers/{{publisher}}/models/{{model}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{publisher}}/{{model}}`
* `{{region}}/{{publisher}}/{{model}}`
* `{{publisher}}/{{model}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import PublisherModelConfig using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    region = "<-optional value->"
    publisher = "<-required value->"
    model = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import PublisherModelConfig using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/publishers/{{publisher}}/models/{{model}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), PublisherModelConfig can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/publishers/{{publisher}}/models/{{model}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{publisher}}/{{model}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config.default {{region}}/{{publisher}}/{{model}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_publisher_model_config.default {{publisher}}/{{model}}
```
